entries.name: Man in kimono
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours, chibi big-head proportions (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Not a numbered wave-1 row: added for the plan's Japanese setting (traditional dress) and as a stand-in toward the samurai gap (row 100, gap-samurai). Kimono_Male from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019) on OpenGameArt, the same CC0 zip, rig, scale and clips as man-casual and man-suit (idle, walk, punch, hit, sit and six more; no run, jump or death clip). The outfit is a fitted, belted jacket and trousers with a hachimaki headband (closer to a martial-arts gi than to a full kimono: no wide sleeves, no hakama, no topknot, no sword), recoloured as an indigo kimono with an ochre obi and headband. Height 1.75 m like man-casual: the chibi proportions (big head) are the artist's, the overall size is a grown man's. The pack also has a Kimono_Female (shipped separately as woman-kimono).
